# Payhere

Easy payment links for accepting online payments

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/payhere/.

## Actions

- **Create Hook**: Subscribe to a REST hook for receiving webhook events.
- **Create Plan**: Create a new payment plan in PayHere.
- **Delete Hook**: Remove a REST hook listener subscription.
- **Get Current Company** (read-only): Fetch company information for the currently authenticated user.
- **Get Current Company Stats** (read-only): Fetch payment statistics for the last 30 days with comparison data from the preceding 30-day period (30-60 days ago).
- **Get User** (read-only): Fetch information on the currently authenticated user.
- **List Customers** (read-only): List all customers from Payhere, ordered chronologically with most recent first.
- **List Payments** (read-only): List all payments ordered chronologically, most recent first.
- **List Plans** (read-only): List all plans in your PayHere account.
- **List REST Hooks** (read-only): List all active REST hooks subscriptions for the authenticated company.
- **List subscriptions** (read-only): List all subscriptions ordered chronologically by most recent payment first.
- **Update Current Company**: Update the company information for the currently authenticated user.
- **Update Plan**: Update an existing plan's configuration and settings.
